d: 4-CHANNEL AMPLIFIERS - 4 Channel x 30 watt @ 4Ω, 8Ω, 70V and 100V per channel. Internal DSP w/ Crossovers, IoT Device with built in Wi-Fi Hotspot, Wi-Fi or FAST Ethernet connectivity. Highly Efficient Power Supply with Class D Output Stage.

specs.label: INPUTS
specs.value: Analog: 4 Balanced Inputs with user selectable 26dB, 34dB, and mic level input sensitivity; 4 unbalanced RCA inputs with user-selectable 26dB and 34dB input sensitivity

specs.label: AMPLIFIER OUTPUT CLASSIFICATION
specs.value: Class D with Proprietary Smart Power Bridge Technology allowing bridged output functionality without sacrificing an amplifier channel

specs.label: DSP ARCHITECTURE
specs.value: Analog Devices Sigma 96kHz DSP Processor with 32-bit Core with Sample Rate Converters

specs.label: INPUT MATRIX & MATRIX MIXER
specs.value: Routable matrix; any input can be mixed to any output

specs.label: CROSSOVERS
specs.value: Up to 48 dB/Octave IIR Filters (Linkwitz Riley and Butterworth)
